value: The 10-29 net prices an exhausted Pummel at about a quarter of its worth: on 200 turn-start positions with Pummel in draw or discard, moving one copy to exhaust changes the net's value by -0.6 HP against -2.2 (0.7) played out by the same player (32 paired futures); the net's change does not grow with the player's Strength (slope 0.00 HP per point against about -2), bosses -3.7 against -13.0; a Strike moved instead: net -0.7, played out +0.35 (0.33).
